paired_gate.promote: At the same checkpoint, a candidate must improve physical MSE/ADE or gripper macro-F1 without material regression in the other key action/range metric, retain finite non-collapsed language and visual counterfactual response, restore max_abs0, and then beat the sparse parent's fixed closed-loop interaction or success evidence.
stop: duplicate or overlapping consumed sample ID
paired_gate.claim_boundary: This selects a dense carrier challenger only. Neither arm is a carrier champion or H3-WAM success until it beats other code-backed carrier families and passes fixed closed-loop success.
